data.body: [P2] Return to the design phase for the grouping option. CONTRIBUTING rule 3 requires an agreed design note before adding an option, and rule 2.5 requires explaining which simpler alternatives were considered and rejected. The supplied description still documents implementation and timings without containing or linking that rationale. Follow rule 8's design process and obtain maintainer agreement; consider deriving groups from generated function settings to avoid duplicating configuration knowledge in `settingsKey` and `CUSTOM_SETTINGS`.
